authorities_and_standards.name: National warning authorities
authorities_and_standards.role: authoritative national warning and action decisions
authorities_and_standards.gcpn_role: consume authority assertions for offline conformance only

authorities_and_standards.name: ITU-T X.1303 CAP
authorities_and_standards.role: common all-hazard alert exchange format across ICT networks
authorities_and_standards.gcpn_role: validate CAP-compatible records and preserve message semantics

authorities_and_standards.name: SADC SHOC
authorities_and_standards.role: regional humanitarian/emergency coordination under SADC mandate

ew4all_pillars.name: disaster risk knowledge
ew4all_pillars.gap: No authoritative national risk assessment, hazard maps, exposure or vulnerability model.

ew4all_pillars.name: detection observations monitoring analysis and forecasting
ew4all_pillars.gap: No sensors, observation service, forecast production or hazard thresholds; real verified outcomes and dependence clusters required.

ew4all_pillars.name: warning dissemination and communication
ew4all_pillars.gap: No CAP gateway, telecom infrastructure, real recipients or field-validated comprehension.

ew4all_pillars.name: preparedness and response capabilities
ew4all_pillars.gap: No dispatch, responder direction, actual protective behaviour, fund release or causal impact evaluation.
